why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with React Native
why_use_section.subtitle: React Native allows us to deliver truly native UIs while maintaining a single, shared codebase.
paragraphs: React Native is our framework of choice for projects that demand native-level responsiveness and access to platform-specific APIs. Unlike hybrid frameworks that rely on WebViews, React Native invokes actual native UI components, ensuring that your application feels right at home on both iOS and Android.

By utilizing the 'New Architecture' (Fabric and TurboModules), we leverage direct C++ integration for high-concurrency tasks. This results in smoother animations, faster startup times, and a highly predictable bridge between your JavaScript logic and the underlying mobile hardware.
